items.html: Also all the creatures and the souls of the righteous — all of them are from the sorting of these kings. And each and every day they are sorted through our prayers and rise upward in the secret of MAN [Mayin Nukvin], and they are corrected, and then they come into the world. And this is the secret of “All Israel are the sons of kings.” And this is the secret of “The Messiah son of David does not come until all the souls in the body are exhausted” — which is this body that is mixed of good and evil. Also all the angels, and all the creatures in heaven and on earth, all of them came to be by force of these sortings.
